items.title: Fix multi-host-authority-smoke E2 assertion: add fileReader isolation to resolveAuthorityVerdictBacking call
items.context: resolveAuthorityVerdictBacking({env:{LATTICE_AUTHORITY_MODE:enforce}}) at line 336 reads authority_trust.env from process.cwd(). Add fileReader: () => empty string to this call so it does not pick up machine-local config.
